subject: Pacific Retail — Renewal: Sequenced Roadmap Workshop & Prework
messages:
From: Emma Taylor <emma.taylor@pacificretail.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@pacificretail.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pacific Retail — Renewal: Sequenced Roadmap Workshop & Prework

Hi Tessa / Monica,

Thanks again for the renewal check-in last week — the execs asked for a short, actionable roadmap session to align on the next 6 months of rollout and outstanding platform dependencies.

We have a hard constraint on the execs' calendar the week of July 7–11: they can only do short meetings (<= 60 min). Could we run a "sequenced" workshop instead of a single half-day: two compact sessions (overview + tech breakout) spaced across two days so stakeholders can attend focused blocks?

Goals:
- Align on priorities for pilot expansion (billing & SSO timelines)
- Identify blockers for Dedicated capacity ramp
- Agree on owners and next steps (mutual action plan)

Attendees (tentative): Emma Taylor (PM), Liam O'Connor (Head of Infra), two product leads.

Can Redwood propose options for:
1) Two 45–50 minute sessions on separate days (US west morning preferred)
2) A short prework doc we can share with execs to keep sessions crisp

Thanks — happy to be flexible with times, just need something that works for exec calendars.

Best,
Emma
Emma Taylor
Senior Product Manager | Pacific Retail

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Emma Taylor <emma.taylor@pacificretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pacific Retail — Renewal: Sequenced Roadmap Workshop & Prework

Thanks Emma — this makes sense and two shorter sessions should be simpler for execs. Draft proposal below (we also attached a short agenda PDF with prework bullets).

Proposed format (compact):
- Session A — Executive overview (45 minutes)
  - Target: alignment on business priorities, success metrics, go/no-go items
  - Redwood owner: Tessa (overview), Vivek (SRE constraints)

- Session B — Technical run-through + mutual action plan (50 minutes)
  - Target: blockers, Dedicated capacity ramp plan, SSO and billing dependencies
  - Redwood owner: Monica (technical lead), Vivek (capacity ops)

Timing options (all PST; we can convert to local times once you confirm preference):
- Option 1: July 8, 09:30–10:15 & July 10, 09:30–10:20
- Option 2: July 9, 08:30–09:15 & July 11, 08:30–09:20
- Option 3: July 8, 10:30–11:15 & July 9, 10:30–11:20

Prework (1 pager we can circulate):
- Current pilot scope & metrics (one slide)
- Top 3 risks and open asks from Pacific Retail

Attachments: roadmap-workshop-agenda_v1.pdf (agenda + prework checklist).

Can you confirm which option (1/2/3) looks best or send two time windows that fit exec availability? If none work we can propose EMEA-overlap windows but would need to confirm which product leads can join.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0192

From: Emma Taylor <emma.taylor@pacificretail.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@pacificretail.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Jun 2025 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pacific Retail — Renewal: Sequenced Roadmap Workshop & Prework

Tessa — thanks, that structure looks great. Quick update on availability: execs have back-to-back external commitments on July 8–9 and prefer sessions split across July 10 and July 14. They asked for even tighter windows: 40–45 minutes each.

Suggested (our calendar):
- Exec overview: Thu, July 10 — 09:30–10:15 PT (45 min)
- Tech/action plan: Mon, July 14 — 09:00–09:45 PT (45 min)

Two asks from our side:
1) Can you make the exec overview strictly timeboxed? (We will enforce a 15-min exec Q&A maximum.)
2) Please send the one-pager prework by EOD July 3 so we can circulate to execs.

On quoting your note:
> Propose Option 1 or Option 2 — we prefer morning PST.

Those mornings work for us if Redwood can hold to the tighter windows. If Vivek or Monica foresee showstopper prep work that needs a longer slot, flag it and we can adjust.

Thanks — Emma

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Emma Taylor <emma.taylor@pacificretail.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Jun 2025 14:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: Pacific Retail — Sequenced Roadmap Workshop (confirmed times + invites)

Great — locking in the two sessions per Emma's availability. Calendar invites attached (calendar_invite.ics) and a short run-of-show in the Drive link below. We've trimmed the exec overview to 40 minutes with a strict 10–15 minute Q&A, and reserved 45 minutes for the technical action-planning session.

Confirmed schedule (PST):
- Exec overview: Thu, July 10, 09:30–10:10 PT (40 min) — owners: Tessa / Vivek
- Tech & mutual action plan: Mon, July 14, 09:00–09:45 PT (45 min) — owners: Monica / Vivek

Action items for Redwood before EOD July 3:
- Tessa: circulate 1-pager prework (attached in roadmap-workshop-agenda_v1.pdf)
- Monica: prepare a short run_of_show_pacretail.xlsx with breakout prompts and capacity slides
- Vivek: verify Dedicated capacity schedule and note any non-starters

Links & attachments:
- Agenda + prework: roadmap-workshop-agenda_v1.pdf
- Run of show: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-placeholder (run_of_show_pacretail.xlsx)
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/4572

We will record both sessions and produce a single mutual action plan doc after the technical session. If anything changes on your side, ping me and we can shift the second session by one day either direction.

Thanks all — looking forward to it.

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
Attachments: run_of_show_pacretail.xlsx (spreadsheet), calendar_invite.ics (invite stub)
